title: Wholesome Jamaican Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with wholesome ingredients, infused with the warmth of Jamaican spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and garlic, cook until softened (5 minutes).
Add curry powder, cook for 1 minute.
Add carrots, sweet potatoes, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer (20 minutes).
Add kombu and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in stew and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
